steps.js: (() => { const heads = [...document.querySelectorAll('th')].map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length; const sels = document.querySelectorAll('tbody .p-select').length; const caption = [...document.querySelectorAll('span,p')].map(e => e.textContent).find(t => t.includes('Показать записи')); const muted = document.body.innerText.includes('Без группы'); return { heads, rows, sels, caption, muted }; })()

(() => { const inp = document.querySelector('.access__search-input'); const r = inp.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs = getComputedStyle(inp); const span = document.createElement('span'); span.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;visibility:hidden;white-space:nowrap;font:' + cs.font; span.textContent = inp.placeholder; document.body.appendChild(span); const pw = span.getBoundingClientRect().width; span.remove(); return { inputW: Math.round(r.width), placeholderW: Math.round(pw), fits: pw <= r.width - 40, placeholder: inp.placeholder }; })()
